appearances.summary: iFlytek's Spark team released Spark-X2.6-4B, a 4B open-weight model under Apache 2.0 with a 1M-token context and none, low or high thinking modes, improved for coding, agents and long context through post-training on the X2.5 architecture. vLLM, Ollama and Hugging Face support it at launch, so small-GPU and on-device users get a long-context agent model.
